answer.item: Tengen reveals that they are the sorcerer who was once Noritoshi Kamo and now is inhabiting Suguru Geto's body.

questions.question: Why does Master Tengen look the way they do, as Tengen explains to Yuji?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Tengen says that they are immortal but is not immune to aging and that is the reason why they look the way they are.

questions.question: What condition does Master Tengen set before answering about Kenjaku's objectives and the Prison Realm?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: When Megumi and Yuta ask Tengen about Kenjaku's objectives and how to unlock the Prison Realm, Tengen says that there is one condition: Yuki Tsukumo, Yuta Okkotsu or Choso must remain as their guards.

questions.question: What is Kenjaku's objective, as Tengen explains to the group?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Tengen explains about how Kenjaku's objective is to force the evolution of all human beings throughout Japan.

questions.question: What method has Kenjaku chosen to carry out his objective?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Tengen reveals that the method Kenjaku has chosen is to merge humankind with themselves.

questions.question: What does Tengen tell the group about what they have become after evolving?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Tengen tells the group that now that they've evolved, they are more cursed spirit than human which makes them a target for cursed spirit manipulation, shocking everyone.

questions.question: What does Yuji tell Megumi after the pair accept the deal?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: After the pair accept the deal, Yuji tells Megumi that all the bluffing he's done was risky, who tells Yuji that it isn't.

questions.question: What time does Yuji find it to be when he checks his phone?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Megumi says he should lie low for tonight but also doesn't want waste anymore time before Tsumuki's deadline as Yuji goes on to check his phone, stating that it's 5 p.m. on the 10th which leaves them nine days.

questions.question: What does Megumi tell Yuji about sneaking in to look for Kinji?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Megumi tells Yuji that he will sneak in to look for Kinji, however, if things get troublesome he's out as Yuji agrees to the plan.

questions.question: What are the two rules the guard tells Yuji about the fight club fights?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: The first rule is not to run away and the second is no usage of cursed techniques.

questions.question: What does the guard tell Yuji just as he goes to open a door?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: The guard goes to open a door as they tell Yuji to look sharp and he will have a possibility to talk to the boss.

questions.question: Who is the announcer at the Gachinko fight club tournament?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: A sudden voice calls out and welcomes everyone to the Gachinko fight club tournament, stating their name to be the announcer, John Bobby.

questions.question: What does Yuji ask Panda during their fight?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: While in battle, Yuji asks Panda if he's met Kinji who declines, telling him that because Kinji is aware of who he is and isn't suspicious of him but he's avoiding him.

questions.question: What happens when Yuji suddenly punches Panda?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji suddenly punches Panda which sends him flying as Panda complains about being unable to move and how the Animal Welfare Society won't allow this.

questions.question: What does Kinji ask Yuji about a job paying 1 million yen a month?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Inside of the room with Kinji, he asks Yuji "if I told there was a job where you could get 1 million yen a month just for doing a certain thing for 1 hour a day, would you believe me?" leaving Yuji confused.

questions.question: How does Yuji respond to Kinji's question about the 1 million yen job?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji tells Kinji that it depends on what the "work" is.

questions.question: How does Kinji react when Yuji comments that the 2 hundred yen price sounds dishonest?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Shocked by this, Yuji comments on how it sounds dishonest which is confirmed by Kinji who says that this is a typical scamming method.

questions.question: What does Kinji say about people without passion?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: He says that people without passion can't fall in love and that both the scammer and the scammed have passion which is: "I'm going to change my life."

questions.question: What does Kinji say about the ones who can't bet big?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: He says that the ones who can't bet big and doesn't know when to call it quits are the ones cast aside from society, he adds on that there isn't a single person on earth who doesn't gamble, what they hate isn't gambling but instead loss and ruin.

questions.question: What does Kinji tell Yuji about the relationship between passion, gambling and love?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: He tells Yuji that passion is gambling, gambling is life and love is control.

questions.question: Why does Kinji say now is the perfect time to expand his fight club business?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: He says that with his fight club he eventually will want to control the country's passion, he says that now is the perfect time to expand his business as the existence of cursed spirits have been publicized and the jujutsu headquarters is barely functional.

questions.question: Why does Yuji ask for no alcohol?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji tells Kinji that it isn't because of that but instead he's underaged, Kinji comments on how Yuji doesn't look like the type to care about that.

questions.question: What does Kinji say when Yuji yells at him to listen?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji yells at Kinji to listen who refuses and says he's already cooled off.

questions.question: What does Yuji tell Megumi and Panda as Kinji readies himself to punch him?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: As the two continue fighting, Yuji is kicked out through a door by Kinji who readies himself to punch Yuji who tells Megumi and Panda to stay out of his fight.

questions.question: How does Yuji describe the feel of Kinji's punches?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji wonders about Kinji's punches which are painful and feels like he's being slugged by a baseball bat with razors.

questions.question: What does Kinji say a sorcerer is basically asking when they ask another sorcerer for help?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Kinji yells at Yuji telling him that when a sorcerer asks another sorcerer for help, they're basically asking "please risk your life with me".

questions.question: What does Yuji say when he appears standing behind Kinji?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Before he could finish his sentence, Kinji is surprised by Yuji standing behind him who says that he's a cog and that cogs have a role.

questions.question: What interrupts Kinji just as he says he'll hit Yuji?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Kinji goes on to say that he'll hit Yuji, however, before he could finish his sentence, Kirara interrupts by asking Kinji if he's getting heated.

questions.question: What does Panda reveal to the group about Yaga?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Panda speaks up by telling them that Yaga has died, he apologizes for keeping quiet about it but confirms it's true.

questions.question: What does Kinji agree to do after the group's short discussion?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: After a short discussion, Kinji agrees to help them with the Culling Game, satisfying Megumi and Yuji.

questions.question: What rule does the Kogane announce a player has added to the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: a Kogane appears over Yuji's head, announcing that a player has added a rule to the Culling Game, rule nine: "players can now view the information of other players such as "name", "points", "number of times they've added rules" and "residing colony".

questions.question: Why does the Kogane sound different all of a sudden?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Megumi asks the Kogane why it sounds different all of a sudden who responds by telling the group it's speaking as the liaison assigned to Yuji which generates a response from Panda who says Master Tengen did say something regarding it.

questions.question: How many people does Yuji figure Kashimo must have killed?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: He continues on by saying Kashimo previously had 200 points and wonders why they added an additional rule which Yuji that they must've killed at least 40 people in the last few days and he doubts the reasons are nice.

questions.question: What does Yuji say they need to find to get Tsumiki out of the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji says they will need to find someone with a 100 points or more who isn't interested in adding rules which Megumi continues his line of thought and says they will need to press that player to make a rule to allow Tsumiki out of the Culling Game.

questions.question: What does Megumi say about friends passing points around?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: He continues on and says that if friends continue to keep passing around points, they won't lose their cursed techniques and die.

questions.question: Who does Megumi say they'll target while looking for the Angel?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji says that they have a plan of action which Megumi says that as they look for the "Angel" to break the prison realm's seal, they'll target Hajime Kashimo and Hiromi Higuruma and hunt them down.

questions.question: Where does Master Tengen say the Angel is?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Megumi tells them that Master Tengen mentioned she's on the eastern side of Tokyo inside the number 2 colony.

questions.question: What does Kinji tell the group about which colony each team will head to?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Kinji asks him if he's sure about that: but he continues on without waiting for a response from Megumi, telling them that he and Panda will go to Tokyo colony number 2 while Megumi and Yuji will go to number 1 and Kirara will be on stand-by outside of the barrier.

questions.question: Why does Kinji say they should have someone observe the situation from outside the barrier?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: He adds on that they haven't been contacted by Yuta, meaning their phones can't be used inside the barrier: so they should have someone observing the the situation from outside.

questions.question: Who confirms with the Kogane that they're ready to enter the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Ready to enter the Culling Game, Yuji, Megumi, Panda and Kinji all ready themselves and confirm with the Kogane that they're ready to enter and become players.

questions.question: What does Megumi tell Yuji they need to beware of before entering the barrier?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Before the two entered the barrier where the Culling Game was taking place, Megumi tells Yuji they need to beware of incarnated sorcerers from the past, and Yuji agrees.

questions.question: Why did past sorcerers likely enter into a contract with Kenjaku?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Fighting to the death used to be a normal thing for sorcerors: and they desired it, which is likely why they entered into a contract with Kenjaku.

questions.question: What does Megumi say they need before entering the barrier?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: He then tells Yuji that they will first need information on Higuruma before entering into the barrier.

questions.question: Where does Yuji end up right after entering the Culling Game barrier?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Now inside the barrier, Yuji falls from the sky and wonders where Megumi is.

questions.question: What does Yuji notice while falling from the sky?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: As he's falling down from the sky, Yuji notices someone standing atop a building and wonders if it's a player guiding him using a light.

questions.question: What does the player who appears ask Yuji?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: As he turns around, yet another Culling Game player appears and yells at Yuji, asking him what he did to his woman.

questions.question: What does Yuji do to get the man off the higher ground?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji charges at the man, suddenly grabbing the individual's leg and throwing him down the building.

questions.question: What happens when Yuji charges his fist to punch the man?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Suddenly, Yuji's hand squirts out blood as the man laughs, asking Yuji if his fist broke and tells him he's the loser of the fight, however, Yuji surprises the man and kicks him, sending him crashing backwards.

questions.question: What does Yuji ask the man about Higuruma?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji shakes his hand and tells the man that it's not broken before walking over to them, asking if he knows about a sorcerer named Higuruma.

questions.question: What does the stranger say Yuji is famous as?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji asks who they are: and they apologize, saying only he only knows who Yuji is because he's famous: identifying Yuji as "The Tiger of West Junior High".

questions.question: What does Amai say about where the stronger players gather?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Amai tells Yuji that the stronger ones gather where the city used to prosper because that's where plenty of supplies are, telling Yuji that Higuruma is in Ikebukuro.

questions.question: What does Rin tell Yuji about his experience against Haba?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Rin tells Yuji he's never met Higuruma but he once beat Haba to a pulp.

questions.question: What does Yuji find Higuruma doing when he enters the theatre?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: As Yuji enters the theatre, he's surprised to find Higuruma in a bathtub who asks him who he is and what he's doing there which Yuji asks as well.

questions.question: What does Higuruma say about the cost of talking to him?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: just as Yuji says he wants to talk, Higuruma tells him to wait as he's a lawyer so talking to him costs 5,000 yen every half hour.

questions.question: What does Yuji conclude after Higuruma's joking lawyer act?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji comes to the conclusion that there's something odd about Higuruma and goes straight to the point of asking Higuruma if he scored 100 points.

questions.question: What does Yuji ask Higuruma to do with his 100 points?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji tells Higuruma that they want to put an end to the Culling Game or rather negating the forced killing, asking Higuruma if they can use his 100 points to add a rule.

questions.question: How does Higuruma respond to Yuji's request?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Higuruma tells Yuji that he'll be blunt and says no, Yuji, clearly annoyed asks if that's a joke as well.

questions.question: What does Yuji say about waiting too long for the Culling Game to end?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji tells Higuruma that the cursed technique removal is part of the Culling Game ritual, adding on that if they wait too long, everyone in the country will die.

questions.question: What does Higuruma say his domain forbids?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Higuruma tells Yuji that his domain forbids the use of violence for the both of them.

questions.question: What crime does Judgeman charge Yuji with?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Judgeman begins by saying Yuji is under suspicion of entering the Maji Vegas Pachinko Parlor on July 16, 2017, in Sendai City, Miyagi Prefecture, despite being under 18 years of age at the time.

questions.question: What does Higuruma say determines the verdict?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Higuruma tells Yuji that Judgeman knows everything about everyone within the domain, but tells Yuji not to worry and that he doesn't have that information, telling Yuji that the verdict depends solely upon the arguments that he and Yuji present.

questions.question: What does Yuji conclude about Higuruma's domain expansion?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: He thinks back to what something Master Tengen said about domains, coming to the conclusion that Higuruma's domain expansion is not necessarily fatal and can't physically harm him, and that it relies on a binding vow that requires an explanation of the rules.

questions.question: What three options does Higuruma give Yuji?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji has three options, silence, confession, and denial.

questions.question: What does Yuji admit to doing in the Pachinko parlor?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji confirms that he went into the parlor but only to take a dump, thinking to himself about how he refuses choose and doesn't know if he can plead for an extenuating circumstances.

questions.question: What evidence does Higuruma pull from the envelope?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: The photo which came from inside the envelope shows an image of Yuji from a security camera at a cash exchange window near Maji Vegas on the day in question.

questions.question: What is the verdict of the first trial?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Judgeman says Yuji is guilty and confiscation.

questions.question: What effect does the confiscation penalty have on Yuji?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: He tells Yuji that the penalty of confiscation temporarily makes it impossible to use cursed techniques but he suspects Yuji doesn't have a cursed technique so the effect must've switched to preventing the use of cursed energy.

questions.question: What crime does Judgeman accuse Yuji of in the second trial?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji gets back up and demands for a second trial which Judgeman responds with the following crime: Yuji Itadori stands accused of mass murder in Shibuya on October 31, 2018.

questions.question: What is the verdict of the second trial?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji confirms that he did it and says he's not lying nor will he deny it, surprising Higuruma as Judgeman calls out guilty, confiscation and death penalty.

questions.question: What defense does Yuji plead against the death penalty?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: The absence of reason and or control signifies non composmentis and that Sukuna possessed his body.

questions.question: What does Higuruma conclude about Yuji and the crime?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Higuruma finishes Yuji's sentence by saying that he's innocent and that he didn't commit that crime.

questions.question: What does Yuji tell Higuruma about the Shibuya murders?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji tells Higuruma that even if he didn't commit that crime, it's still his fault because he was too weak.

questions.question: What does Higuruma say he remembered when Yuji asks why he dispelled his cursed technique?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Higuruma continues staring up at the ceiling as Yuji asks why he dispelled his cursed technique who tells Yuji he remembered why he got into law in the first place.

questions.question: What rule does Higuruma ask the Kogane to add?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Higuruma asks for the kogane to add a rule: making it possible to transfer points between players.

questions.question: What does Higuruma say about his two remaining points?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Higuruma tells him that his two left over points are from the judge and prosecutor he killed before coming to Tokyo and when the barrier opens, he'll turn himself in.

questions.question: What terms does the Angel give for unsealing Gojo?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Two days after Megumi wakes up in a hotel spotting Yuji, Hana, and Takaba, who all discuss how to go about their collected points as they gathered enough to save Tsumiki, the Angel residing in Hana gives her terms to unseal Gojo from the prison realm which is to kill "The disgraced one" to which Sukuna reveal to Yuji is himself.

questions.question: What rule do Yuji and Megumi decide to implant after learning about Tengen?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: After that is resolved Yuji and Megumi learn from Maki that Tengen was taken by Kenjaku, they decide to implant rule 11 to allow a player to leave the game by inviting another as a substitute

questions.question: What does Tsumiki do instead of leaving the game with the 100 points?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: the 100 points are given to Tsumiki so she can leave the game but instead she adds a new rule of allowing entry and exist across all colonies, causing Megumi to realize she isnt actually Tsumiki.

questions.question: Who is "Tsumiki" actually?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: "Tsumiki" reveals she is actually Yorozu who incarnated into Tsumiki's body and reveals her only wish is to fight Sukuna, as she then flies off to wait for him

questions.question: How does Sukuna take possession of Megumi's body?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: He knocks out Hana and then transfers his curse energy into a finger then tears it off to feed it to Megumi, causing Sukuna to take possession of Megumi's body.

questions.question: What deal do Gojo and Sukuna reach after the preparations to free Gojo?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: On November 19 they begin the preparations to free Gojo from the prison realm which ended in success with an agreement being made By Gojo and Sukuna to fight on December 24th giving him a month to prepare.

questions.question: What does Kusakabe explain about Yuji's body remembering Sukuna's techniques?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Kusakabe talked to Yuji on how due to Sukuna taking over his body and utilizing advanced cursed techniques his own body remembered and picked up on it, and with that logic Ui Ui's cursed technique of swapping souls would be helpful in memorizing the basics of cursed energy manipulation, barrier techniques, and Simple Domain that Kusakabe would be teaching to him.

questions.question: Who ends up teaching Yuji about blood manipulation?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Choso was not able to accurately describe it to Yuji so Noritoshi took over teaching and explaining it to Yuji.

questions.question: What conclusion does Hana reach from Tsukumo's notes?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Hana comments on the content's of Tsukumo's notes on how two souls cannot become one, in the case of a cursed object and a non sorcerer, coming to the conclusion that as long as there isn't a cursed technique like Mahito's being used it should be possible to awaken Megumi's soul, to which Hana backs up.

questions.question: What does Noritoshi offer during the strategy meeting on dealing with Sukuna?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: During another meeting on a strategy to deal with Sukuna, Noritoshi offers to drop out for the sake of seeing his family and Yuji thanks him for being able to teach him noting that Choso "couldn't teach for squat" he then goes over Higuruma's plan to use Judgeman on the king of curses.

questions.question: Why does Yuta decline to have Hakari and Gojo's techniques copied?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji suggested that Hakari and Gojo's techniques be copied and have their consumed limb be regenerated, though Yuta declined as the cursed techniques value drops to zero once the limb regenerates, further explaining that this was the reason Hana and Inumaki allowed their bisected arms to be copied.

questions.question: What plan does Yuta finally reveal to Yuji?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuta then finally revealed to Yuji his plan of having his own finger act as ruse to copy, due to Sukuna's cursed techniques having been ingrained in Yuji's flesh.

questions.question: What does Gojo tell Yuji about what he wants him to do should he die?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Gojo then told Yuji that he wanted him to carry on his wishes and dream should he die, expressing that he believed Yuji's generation would surpass him, while also hoping that at least one grows strong enough to forget and be strong in ways he could not.

questions.question: How do Yuji and the other sorcerers watch the fight between Gojo and Sukuna?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji along with his fellow sorcerers watched the fight between Gojo and Sukuna via broadcast while inside of Rika

questions.question: What plan do Yuta and Rika operate with to separate Sukuna from Megumi?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuta and Rika intervene to provide backup, operating on a plan to kill and separate Sukuna from Megumi with Yuta's domain.

questions.question: How do Yuji and Yuta answer Sukuna's question about their improved cursed energy?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Sukuna inquires on what they did the past month to improve their cursed energy this much, to which Yuji responds that he "worked hard and persevered" while Yuta merely states they "cheated"

questions.question: What does Yuta reveal about the last of his 20 cursed fingers?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuta reveals to him that he had Rika eat the last of his 20 cursed fingers (a bluff in which it was actually Yuji's finger)

questions.question: What does Yuji learn when he accesses the barrier of Megumi and Sukuna's soul?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji was then able to access the barrier of Megumi and Sukuna's soul only to learn Megumi had lost his will to leave

questions.question: Why does Yuji think the severed arm gives them the opening they need?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: After attacking Sukuna Maki took the opportunity to cut off one of Sukuna's arms, prompting Yuji to charge forward thinking on how with Sukuna can no longer use reverse cursed technique or hand signs to use the world cutting slash.

questions.question: How does Yuji use Piercing Blood for the first time on Sukuna?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji rejoined the battle and separated Sukuna from Choso taking over the fight, and from his brothers instructions Yuji used Piercing Blood for the first time on Sukuna.

questions.question: What happens when Yuji launches his own Black Flash?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji then readied himself to launch his own Black Flash on Sukuna and with the help of Larue's cursed technique that distracted the King of curses it landed successfully, awakening his potential.

questions.question: What does Yuji gain from the consumption of the Death Painting?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Due to the factors of the consumption of Death Painting No. 4-9, Yuji was engraved with Blood Manipulation, the inherited technique of the Kamo Clan, along with that he possessed another cursed technique, because of the Black Flash awakening and drawing it out from within, Yuji activated Shrine, with Sukuna making note of these factors.

questions.question: How does Yuji deal with Sukuna's incomplete domain?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: After these attacks Sukuna activated an incomplete domain Malevolent Shrine, which Yuji picked up upon and used Simple Domain to reduce the damage.

questions.question: What does Choso do to protect Yuji from Divine Flame?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Due to Divine Flame's heat results in decompression and over-pressure, that would cause incineration to all living being inside the domain, Choso forms a blood barrier to protect his brother at the cost of his own life.

questions.question: What does Choso apologize for in the vision?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: In a vision Yuji and Choso talk with one another with Choso apologizing for being a bad teacher and musing that its only natural for the younger brother to surpass the elder, with Yuji not seeing that as a reason for his brother to lose his life.

questions.question: What does Todo tell Yuji when he arrives?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Todo arrives at the scene telling Yuji their allies are probably alright and will do battle once more with Sukuna now that his techniques have exhausted.

questions.question: How had the Vibraslap improved Boogie Woogie?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji recognized that Boogie Woogie's activation with a Vibraslap had changed and improved the technique in allowing for 50 swaps per second, likening it to a roulette wheel.

questions.question: What interrupts Sukuna's attempt to use his domain on Yuji?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Despite the figure appearing to be Satoru Gojo, it was in reality Yuta who had taken possession of the formers body as a last resort, impressed by this Sukuna punched Yuji aside to fight Yuta.

questions.question: What does Yuji use Dismantle on in an attempt to awaken Megumi's soul?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: After spotting an opening Yuji used Dismantle on the "barrier" of Sukuna's soul in an attempt to awaken Megumi's soul, causing Sukuna to cough up his own fingers.

questions.question: How does Todo take the Black Flash that was meant for Hana?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji proceeded to chase after him, while Todo took the blow of the Black Flash for Hana, which launched them both into a building leaving them out of commission.

questions.question: How does Yuji entrap Sukuna within his domain?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: However, to Sukuna's shock, Yuji began forming hand signs, with his previous replacement training with Kusakabe Yuji learned the basics of barrier techniques and proceeded to activate his Domain Expansion entrapping Sukuna within it.

questions.question: What does Yuji's domain contain?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Within Yuji's Domain was an apparition of a train station from his memories, Sukuna then woke up within it on a bench, donning his possessed form of Yuji. Yuji himself greeted Sukuna, and told the King of Curses "lets go" which left Sukuna in utter confusion.

questions.question: Why did Yuji conjure the domain setting of his hometown?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: As the two walked out of the station, Yuji explained that he conjured this domain setting in an attempt to communicate with Sukuna as the two walked about in the town Yuji grew up in.

questions.question: What place from his childhood does Yuji take Sukuna to?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: One of which was Kowai farm, a place Wasuke took Yuji to that had a horse stable, Yuji reflected on this moment on how Wasuke did far more parenting in the place of his father and mother.

questions.question: What winter memories does Yuji recount?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: The domain shifted to a winter memory as Yuji recounted memories of when he used to see snow sculptures for his towns winter festival, a time where he drank sweet milk tea next to his grandfather after shoveling snow, and a time where he heard bells around Christmas making him believe Santa was real, only to later realize they were from the snow chains on car tires.

questions.question: What does Yuji say he could not forgive?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji further stated that the way someone died did not matter, but rather it was the idea of someone treating those lives as worthless that he could not forgive.

questions.question: Why did Yuji bring Sukuna into his domain?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji finally explained that he brought Sukuna into his domain to show him the livelihood of the people the former sees no value in.

questions.question: What does Yuji offer Sukuna in exchange for releasing Megumi's soul?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji coldly confirmed this and told the King of Curses that he can kill him inside this domain, and told him to release possession of Megumi's soul, then Yuji would spare his life by having Sukuna return to his body as a vessel.

questions.question: How does Sukuna respond to Yuji's offer?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Sukuna grew furious and declared he would severe Yuji's head and kill everyone he cared for.

questions.question: What does Megumi tell Yuji about his dream?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Megumi then told him his dream was to create a world that would not expose any injustice to Tsumiki, and how his ideal life would be them living a mundane lifestyle where he would see Yuji and Tsumiki off.

questions.question: What does Yuji admit he can't tell Megumi?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Reaching this conclusion he admitted to Megumi he could not tell him to keep on living after everything he went through, but still told him with a tear filled sentence that he would be lonely without him.

questions.question: What does Yuji reveal about the broken gauntlet?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji revealed the broken gauntlet was hiding two missing fingers.

questions.question: What happens to the 20th finger at Jujutsu headquarters?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: At headquarters Nobara Kugisaki struck the finger with Resonance, binding the King of Curses in place, Yuji immediately realized this was due to Nobara and teared up knowing his friend was still alive while the domain's guaranteed hit struck Sukuna with Dismantle.

questions.question: How does Yuji land the final blow on Sukuna?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji announced to Sukuna that it was time to put an end to the cycle of curses and promptly struck the King of Curses with a domain-amplified Black Flash directly to the chest, making his eyes go blank.

questions.question: What happens to Sukuna after his soul is stripped from Megumi's body?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: With this blow Sukuna's soul was stripped away from Megumi's body as the domain collapsed, reducing the King of Curses to a to a fading cursed mass.

questions.question: Who wrote the letters Yuji gives Megumi and Nobara?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji then gave Megumi and Nobara letters he got from Shoko, revealing that they were written by and given to her by Gojo, while he was not given one due to talking with him in person.

questions.question: Why do the trio tell Megumi they need to head back to headquarters?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Afterward, Yuji and Nobara told Megumi that they all needed to head back to headquarters in order to "save Yuta" from Maki's wrath.

questions.question: What does Kusakabe conclude about Yuji's friends feeling guilty?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Ultimately Kusakabe concludes that everyone's decisions lead to the current outcome so Yuji and his friends don't need to feel guilty.

questions.question: How did Yuta manage to return to his body?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji then asked Yuta how he managed to return to his body, to where the latter explained that he was in a state of near death after cursed technique recovery, though Rika and Shoko managed to heal his original body with reverse cursed technique and safely placed Yuta's brain back into his own body.

questions.question: Who does Ijichi's new mission involve?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Later, Ijichi briefed Yuji, Megumi, and Nobara on the details of a new mission, where the girlfriend of a 26 year old Sota Fukuzawa had his face cursed two weeks ago.

questions.question: What does Megumi conclude the curse user likely is?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Further concluding that due to the lack of malice the curse user was likely a surviving culling game player but did not fully rule out the possibility of this being a semi grade 1 curse spirit holding back akin to what happened at Yasohachi bridge.

questions.question: What does Megumi deduce about the technique's radius?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Ultimately Megumi deduced that the technique had a radius of 50-100 meters as the trio think of an area that would allow them to see and notice when the technique reactivates.

questions.question: Why does Megumi shut down the trip by car suggestion?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji then mocked Nobara back for this, and when she suggested the girlfriend and her partner take a trip by car Megumi pointed out that suspect could likely have a cursed technique to track the girlfriend making tailing the couple and tracking the suspect difficult as they would have to rely on sight.

questions.question: What plan does the trio settle on for catching the suspect?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji and Nobara grew annoyed and argued with Megumi for shutting down the plans, but he decided the best way would be to naturally have the girlfriend leave the cursed techniques range and wait for the suspect to reactivate it at an optimal distance, using a 40-floor condominium as its top floor was 150 meters above ground and it the best place to test this plan.

questions.question: Who turns out to be the curse user?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: After questioning him the trio realized the cursed user was a disgruntled customer from the girlfriends hostess club that was resentful she did not remember the purse he bought her.

questions.question: How does the trio capture the suspect?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Before he can escape, Megumi used Divine Dog to capture him and scolded Yuji and Nobara for lacking focus.

questions.question: What does Yuji tell the detained curse user?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji told the curse user that as long as he acknowledged where he went wrong he can atone and work with him as a team.

questions.question: What did Yuji do with the last Sukuna finger?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: As the trio leave the scene Nobara asked Yuji what he did with the last Sukuna finger, where he revealed he discarded it to act as a talisman to the bewilderment of his friends.

questions.question: When it begins to snow, what does Yuji tell Yuko Ozawa?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuko asked Yuji if he still liked snow and he told her that it was indeed still special to him.

questions.question: When Yuji meets Iori Okkotsu following the birth of his daughter, what does he say?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji spoke to him about an unknown matter with him telling Iori "It doesn't matter" before leaving.

questions.question: How did Yuji's fight with the Curse User Masaki Takeda go?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Based on how Masaki describes the encounter, Yuji had completely overwhelmed him.

questions.question: What does Yuji tell Nobara at the funeral of Hana Kurusu?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: he notified Nobara he could no longer bear attending the funerals of his deceased friends, feeling guilt over witnessing them age while he cannot.

questions.question: What is Yuji doing by late 2086 and early 2087?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: By late 2086 and early 2087, Yuji roams the streets while Jujutsu Headquarters attempt to locate him.

questions.question: How does Yuji intervene in the 2087 dispute between the Jujutsu sorcerers and the Simurians?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: While charging Piercing Blood, Yuji melancholically notes he knew this would happen and fires Piercing Blood into the building containing both parties: detaining all the individuals involved except for Miyaguni.

questions.question: How does Yuji deal with the Simurian Osuki?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Immediately after Yuji intercepts a blow from the Simurian Osuki, catching his axe in the process. While complementing Osuki's strength, Yuji channels his cursed energy into his fist and delivers a Black Flash, sending Osuki flying.

questions.question: What does Yuji tell Mino about the incapacitated sorcerers and Simurians?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: While noting that he'll survive it, Yuji fires a strand of blood at Mino before telling him that the incapacitated sorcerers and Simurians will be fine after a few days.

questions.question: What does Yuji tell Mino when pressed on his inaction toward Yuka and Dabura Karaba's battle?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: When pressed on his inaction toward Yuka and Dabura Karaba's battle he tells Mino that it "Doesn't matter".

questions.question: What does Yuji say is his role as an old soldier?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji explains his role as an old soldier is to exorcise the cursed spirits that leak out of Tokyo, and that he will deal with Dabura should Yuka lose.

questions.question: What does Yuji realize when the cursed spirits begin swarming into the city?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji notices the cursed spirits beginning to swarm into the city, realizing the other sorcerers did not anticipate the amount of curses that would multiply without the great purification ritual.

questions.question: Who turns out to be the key to Maru's technique?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: The "key", described as a "resident" of the afterlife path, turns out to be none other than Mahito, who had been anticipating his death, Yuji is alarmed before reverting to his typical stoic stare.

questions.question: What does Yuji conclude is Maru's plan?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji concludes that Maru's plan is to the his spaceships Mul, Yuta's stored cursed energy, and Mahito's cursed technique to manipulate the souls of the Japanese population to ensure cursed spirits cannot be born from them.

questions.question: How does Yuji respond to Mahito's Idle Transfiguration?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji responds by using Dismantle in response, simultaneously dismembering Mahito and destroying the surrounding buildings.

questions.question: What options do Yuji and Maru consider to stop cursed spirits from being born?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: In order to ensure they could no longer be born, they would either have to eliminate cursed energy from all Japanese citizens or turn every citizen into Jujutsu Sorcerer's. However, Maru relays the logistical issues with the second option as it would replace cursed spirits with curse users with Yuji agreeing, the two conclude that the plan should also include Simurians to avoid further conflict.

questions.question: Why does Yuji call Maru's plan a sin?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji goes on to point out that by doing this, the possibility of using cursed energy as a back up resource will no longer be feasible and that they would be tampering with the bodies of countless citizens without consent.

questions.question: What does Yuji warn Maru about even if the plan succeeds?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji explains that he likely still not age in the next 300 years and should therefore accept the consequences and punishments while he is still alive, however he warns Maru that he will have to directly target the cursed energy of cursed spirits as they will likely still be born even if the plan succeeds.

questions.question: Why will cursed energy continue to accumulate even if it is purged from the Japanese?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji explains that are rare instances of foreigners that emit faint traces of cursed energy, which occasionally accumulates into cursed spirits every now and then. Given that cursed spirits overseas have become public knowledge for the past couple decades, Yuji concludes that the cursed energy overseas that has already flowed into Tokyo will continue to accumulate if cursed energy is purged from the Japanese.

questions.question: What does Yuji suggest to Maru about the Kalyan and cursed spirit conflict?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Maru laments that even this wont stop humanity and Simurians from colliding over the cursed spirit and Kalyan issue, prompting Yuji to suggest he bring harmony to the cursed spirits instead.

questions.question: What do Yuji and Maru realize about Kalyans, cursed spirits, and Rumelians?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: After Maru discovers that Kalyans, cursed spirits, and Rumelians have the same color souls, both he and Yuji come to realize that this is the reason behind Kalyans not attacking Rumelians and the source of the conflict

questions.question: What does Yuji tell Jujutsu Headquarters about the plan?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Later, Yuji tells Jujutsu Headquarters to blame the lack of future Jujutsu Sorcerers on him and tell the public Maru was merely following his orders so as to avoid negative campaigns against the Simurians.

questions.question: Why had Yuji been avoiding his friends?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji explains he was scared of his friends dying and of his own nigh immortality, wishing to simply avoid meddling with the present and to keep distance from the remainder of his loved ones.

questions.question: What is Yuji's plan for keeping the threat of cursed spirits to a minimum?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: For starters, they must exorcise cursed spirits immediately after they are born and teach the current generation how to use barrier and exorcism techniques. Next they will have to track down every physically gifted individual and trace out their bloodline, and finally mass produce cursed tools.

questions.question: What does Yuji propose should happen when he dies?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji proposes that when he dies he should be made into a cursed object, and that for the next 200-300 years he'll keep the threat of cursed spirits to a minimum.
